gen-gf-handlee-fs-supreme: Supreme holds a crisp, heavy-looking line of text, its curves left open rather than curled shut. And Handlee's hand-drawn wedge of pen pressure gives that sturdiness something casual to lean against.
gen-gf-handlee-general-sans:
Tightly gathered, hand-drawn letters give Handlee its casual grace.

General Sans follows with a round-tipped pen line and an x-height that fills the line, so a longer stretch of text moves smoothly around every bend.
gen-gf-handlee-manrope:
Approachable and a little breezy, Manrope opens each curve with a bright gap.

Beneath Handlee's casual heading, its traced-with-one-stylus width keeps a longer stretch of text smooth and unfussy, with hardly any step from capitals to lowercase.
gen-gf-handlee-montserrat:
Handlee's counters spill out loosely, like handwriting that never learned to squeeze.

It earns its keep big and short as a heading, while Montserrat's single-depth cut and oversized e and a counters carry the text beneath.
gen-gf-handlee-satoshi:
Casual and graceful, Handlee sets a hand-drawn tone with just a light touch of stroke modulation.

And Satoshi sits beneath it with a soaring x-height and a wide-open e, so no thin stroke vanishes in glare.
gen-gf-handlee-switzer:
Hand-drawn, loose, and quietly alive.

Handlee's strokes vary just enough to feel human, and Switzer answers with tubular, wire-like letters and a tall waist line, giving the page a Swiss steadiness under the handwriting.
gen-gf-handlee-work-sans:
Work Sans reads modern and straightforward, its joins as thick as its strokes and its mean line set high.

But Handlee's mild thicks and casual, tightly gathered letters give the pair its real charm: a loose hand over a firm plain sans.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-epunda-slab:
Happy Monkey draws every line ruler-straight, with wide gaps in the e that look bold and distinctive.

And where it makes its mark up top, Epunda Slab does its best work below, with tall rounded lowercase and a visibly gaping c.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-fauna-one:
Fauna One reads literary, with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders.

Next to it, Happy Monkey feels bolder and blunter, its bowls never swelling, so the two sit together like a shout beside a murmured sentence.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-glegoo:
Happy Monkey keeps its diagonals as heavy as its verticals, which gives it a blunt, distinctive stance.

But Glegoo's big counters and wide-mouthed curves keep a longer stretch of serif text refined and easy on the eye.
